title: Raktaveer - Blood Donation Mobile App
description: A mobile-first blood donation platform with donor matching and request tracking workflows.

story.problem: Blood request workflows needed faster matching and clearer coordination between donors and recipients.
story.approach: I focused on schema design and matching logic to make donor discovery and request handling more reliable.
story.architecture: Built an Express backend with MongoDB collections for donors and requests, then implemented polling-based notifications and compatibility filters in the mobile flow.
story.results: The platform delivered a structured donor-request pipeline, improving response visibility and coordination speed.
